senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שמר, cmp. סָמַר) [pointed,] thorn; flint, diamond; (in legend) shamir, a worm that cuts stones with its glance.
units: Sot. IX, 12 משחרב … בטל הש׳ with the destruction of the Temple the shamir ceased to exist.
<cite ref="Sotah 48b:14">Ib. 48ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:1">Tosef. ib. XV, 1</cite>; Y. ib. IX, 24ᵇ; a. e.
